Village Square.description: You are in the bustling village square. A well sits in the center, and shops line the perimeter. A path leads north out of the village.

Ruins Entrance.description: You stand at the entrance to a crumbling ruin. A large, ancient gate blocks the way forward. The path you came from is to the south.

Dark Forest.description: You are in a dark, foreboding forest. The trees are thick and block out most of the light. A path leads west back to the ruins.

QUEST.name: Find the Crown
QUEST.intro: The village elder begs you to recover the stolen Crown from the ruins beyond the Ancient Gate and return it safely.
